compatibility: Exact schema version only; no implicit coercion, stripping, upgrade or defaults.
authorization: Schemas are data validation, never permission. All proposals and risk results deny execution. Human recovery requires authenticated, one-time server-bound challenge verification.
hashSemantics: SHA-256 lowercase hex over UTF-8. Structured JSON uses lexicographic Unicode code-point object keys, compact separators, unescaped Unicode and safe integers; decimals are strings. Arrays retain order. Strings hash raw UTF-8; Uint8Array hashes exact original bytes. Original Gamma artifact hashes must be verified against original bytes, not converted Vertex records. Dataset contentHash binds the stored dataset bytes, not the manifest. Hash format validation does not prove artifact integrity.
timestampSemantics: Proleptic Gregorian calendar, four-digit astronomical years 0000-9999 (year zero is a leap year). Require YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, optional 1-9 fractional digits, then uppercase Z or signed HH:mm offset (hours 00-23, minutes 00-59; either signed zero offset denotes UTC). Reject invalid calendar dates, leap seconds, hour 24, missing seconds and excess precision. Compare exact signed epoch nanoseconds; scale millisecond bounds by 1000000 using integer arithmetic. Offset-equivalent spellings denote equal instants, including before 1970. Preserve original source strings for hashing; never normalize or truncate them.
eventIdentity: event- plus SHA-256 of the validated envelope excluding eventId and receivedAt. Producers persist occurredAt/effectiveAt/idempotencyKey; consumers deduplicate eventId and reject idempotency-key reuse with changed content. Use parseReplayableEventEnvelope to reject noncanonical source graphs and verify identity. Parsed event graphs and readonly public artifacts are deeply frozen, including every nested object and array.
chartSemantics: Renderer-neutral observations, not orders. Collections may arrive in any order; use explicit IDs/timestamps. Volume bins are half-open and non-overlapping. Never infer aggressor side. Always display synthetic/real, entitlement and freshness labels.
refinementPolicy: JSON Schema covers structural validation. runtimeInvariants describe additional source-Zod checks; native adapters must implement them and replay the shared fixtures. JSON Schema alone is not full acceptance. No adapter may authorize trades. Identifier arrays must be unique. Every integer excludes negative zero before hashing. Every string contains only Unicode scalar values. Artifact graphs contain only dense undecorated arrays and plain records with enumerable string data properties; reject cycles, hidden/symbol keys, accessors and unsupported values.

Timestamp: Follow timestampSemantics exactly; lexical JSON Schema alone does not prove Gregorian calendar validity. All temporal ordering, equality and age checks use exact epoch nanoseconds without rewriting source strings.
PositiveDecimal: Exact fixed-point value is greater than zero; no binary float conversion.
GammaProvenance: replayManifestId is replay-manifest- plus first 24 lowercase hex characters of manifestHash; original artifact integrity still requires hash verification.
Freshness: missing requires observedAt=null; fresh/stale require observedAt; age=evaluatedAt-observedAt must be nonnegative; fresh iff age<=maxAgeMs; stale iff age>maxAgeMs; unknown never proves freshness.
Entitlement: granted requires expiresAt>checkedAt; expired requires nonnull expiresAt<=checkedAt; unknown and denied never prove entitlement.
MarketDataSource: synthetic requires nonnull syntheticReason; real requires syntheticReason=null.
Quote: bid<=ask; sourceTimestamp<=receivedAt<=freshness.evaluatedAt; freshness.observedAt and sourceTimestamp denote the same instant.
VolumeProfile: startAtInclusive<endAtExclusive; sorting bins by lower boundary must produce disjoint half-open ranges; retain original array order.
DatasetManifest: startAtInclusive<endAtExclusive<=captureTime; asOfAt<=captureTime; available vintage requires dataVintageId and unavailable requires null.
ResearchEvidence: sourceIdentity.contentHash=contentHash; publishedAt is null or <=capturedAt; sourceUri is public HTTPS with no userinfo/query/fragment; use canonical public permalinks.
KnowledgeImport: source IDs, content hashes, unavailable IDs and duplicate mapping source IDs are individually unique; unavailable IDs cannot be present sources; declared content hashes exactly cover sources; both sides of each non-self duplicate mapping exist and have its hash; do not merge equal-content source identities.
BacktestRun: trainingWindow.endAtExclusive<=testWindow.startAtInclusive; leakage check kinds unique; accepted requires resultsRef and all five evidenced passed checks.
TradeIntent: limitPrice required only for limit/stop-limit; stopPrice required only for stop/stop-limit; applicable prices are positive exact multiples of positive tickSize; quote instrument matches and quoteAsOf/sourceTimestamp denote the same instant; source real/fresh and entitlement granted; quote age at proposedAt within maxAgeMs; freshness.evaluatedAt and entitlement.checkedAt<=proposedAt<entitlement.expiresAt; proposedAt<expiresAt; proposalOnly=true and executionAuthorized=false.
RiskDecision: research-accepted/paper-eligible require fresh data and nonempty all-passed exposure checks; passed exposure observed nonnull and <=limit; authorizationExpiry=null and both authorization flags false.
ExecutionReceipt: filled+remaining=total using exact decimals; unknown requires unknown-outcome and all other statuses forbid that error; not-submitted/rejected require zero filled; other observed known statuses require brokerOrderRef; filled requires zero remaining; partially-filled requires both positive; submitted requires zero filled. Observation only.
AgentRun: completed requires nonempty outputArtifactIds and no errors; token and USD budgets remain separately enforced by the future worker.
BrokerRecoveryStatus: requested/in-progress/completed recovery requires lastHumanRequestId; infrastructure observation and even authenticated handshake never enable trading.
RecoveryRequest: confirmedAt<=requestedAt<expiresAt; requestedAt-confirmedAt<=300000ms and expiresAt-confirmedAt<=300000ms; future handler must verify/consume actor-bound challenge, not trust this structural declaration.
EventEnvelope: receivedAt>=occurredAt; environment matches payload for trade proposals, execution observations, broker status and recovery requests; verify computed content identity separately; array ordering remains hash-significant.
